title: Recognition Loop Dynamics Differentiates m6A-mRNA Reader Domains of YTHDF Proteins.
authors: Li, Yaozong; Bedi, Rajiv Kumar; Ojeda-May, Pedro; Caflisch, Amedeo
journal: Journal of chemical theory and computation
one_liner_zh: 该文结合晶体学、ITC和分子动力学模拟，研究YTHDF蛋白识别m6A-mRNA的构象动态与二聚化差异，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算模拟研究，但方法创新性一般。
abstract: The three human YTH-domain family proteins (YTHDF1, YTHDF2, and YTHDF3) are highly homologous and recognize the N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification of mRNA with essentially identical binding modes and affinities. This homogeneity challenges the well-established view that different YTHDF proteins play distinct cellular functions (the specificity view), with an emerging argument that these proteins may instead play redundant roles. To study this apparent discrepancy, we investigated the mechanism of binding of m6A-containing RNA using mutagenesis, X-ray crystallography, isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), and molecular dynamics simulations. Specifically, we compared different properties of YTHDF proteins, including their binding capacities to m6A-RNA, conformational changes, and homodimerization propensity. Our results show that the YTHDF proteins share an identical binding mode of m6A-RNA, which requires rare protonation of m6A for binding. Additionally, the three proteins share a similar open-closed switch for their recognition loop regulating the m6A binding. On the other hand, ITC data and crystal structures provide consistent evidence that the YTHDF proteins differ significantly in the flexibility of the recognition loop and its conformational preferences. Only YTHDF1 can homodimerize, which prevents binding to m6A-RNA. Furthermore, we integrate the available biophysical and biochemical evidence to define both the shared and distinct features of YTHDF1-3 in m6A-RNA recognition and propose a hybrid model that reconciles the redundancy-specificity debate. Finally, we discuss the limitations of the work and propose experiments for validating the presented model.
abstract_zh: 三个人类YTH结构域家族蛋白（YTHDF1、YTHDF2和YTHDF3）高度同源，并以基本相同的结合模式和亲和力识别mRNA的N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）修饰。这种同质性挑战了不同YTHDF蛋白发挥不同细胞功能的既定观点（特异性观点），而一种新兴论点则认为这些蛋白可能发挥冗余作用。为研究这一明显矛盾，我们通过诱变、X射线晶体学、等温滴定量热法（ITC）和分子动力学模拟，研究了含m6A RNA的结合机制。具体而言，我们比较了YTHDF蛋白的不同特性，包括其与m6A-RNA的结合能力、构象变化及同源二聚化倾向。我们的结果表明，YTHDF蛋白共享m6A-RNA的相同结合模式，该模式需要m6A的罕见质子化才能结合。此外，这三种蛋白对其调控m6A结合的识别环具有相似的开闭开关。另一方面，ITC数据和晶体结构提供了一致证据，表明YTHDF蛋白在识别环的灵活性及其构象偏好方面存在显著差异。仅YTHDF1能发生同源二聚化，这阻止了其与m6A-RNA的结合。进一步地，我们整合现有的生物物理和生化证据，以定义YTHDF1-3在m6A-RNA识别中的共享和独特特征，并提出一个混合模型，以调和冗余-特异性之争。最后，我们讨论了本工作的局限性，并提出了验证所提出模型的实验方案。
